headlines.title: 桥水中国在7月股市暴跌中仅受“轻伤”，宏观基金较量化基金更为抗跌
headlines.summary: 包括桥水本地分支机构在内，中国境内的宏观对冲基金在7月市场暴跌之中只是受了点“轻伤”，在其他基金今年以来的回报率转为负值的情况下表现相对坚挺。 彭博新闻社看到的一封致投资者信函显示，管理着超过600亿元人民币（89亿美元）资产的桥水中国告诉投资者，其全天候增强基金上个月的费用扣除前亏损为2.8%，但今年截至7月31日整体仍上涨了约3%。

headlines.title_en: Bridgewater China suffers only 'minor bruises' in July stock rout; macro funds prove more resilient than quant funds
headlines.summary_en: Including the local Bridgewater affiliate, China-domiciled macro hedge funds suffered only 'minor injuries' during July's market rout, holding up relatively well while other funds' year-to-date returns turned negative. In a letter to investors seen by Bloomberg News, Bridgewater China, which manages over RMB 60 billion ($8.9 billion) in assets, told investors its All Weather Enhanced fund lost 2.8% before fees last month but was still up about 3% year-to-date through July 31.

headlines.title_en: Two-year German bond yield rises 5 basis points; medium- and long-term German bond yields hit highest since 2011
headlines.summary_en: Tuesday (Aug 18) European late session: Germany's 10-year Bund yield rose 3.8 bps, climbing for a third straight session (up 12.8 bps cumulatively in that period), to 3.259%, staying higher all day; 'opened higher' at 3.240% at 14:29 Beijing time, held near 3.255% for most of the session, reached 3.272% at 21:30 U.S. stock market open, approaching the May 5, 2011 high of 3.333%, April 11, 2011 high of 3.505%, Sep 22, 2008 high of 4.283%, and Jul 23, 2008 high of 4.699%. 2-year German yield rose 5.0 bps to 2.853%, trading in a 2.817%-2.861% range; 30-year German yield rose 2.4 bps, up 13 over the last three days.

headlines.title_en: US Stocks Close: Three Major Indices Fall, SK Hynix Down 9%
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, Aug 19: U.S. stocks closed Tuesday with Dow preliminarily down 0.2%, S&P 500 down 0.69%, Nasdaq down 1.33%. SanDisk (SNDK.O) fell 9%, Western Digital (WDC.O) fell 7%, Micron (MU.O) fell 7%, SK Hynix (SKHY.O) fell over 9%, Nvidia (NVDA.O) fell 2%. Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index closed down 1%, Alibaba (BABA.N) rose 2.8%.
